title: Homogeneity of the Euclidean coefficient norm: |cα| = |c|·|α|
statement: For all P, q ∈ ℕ, every c ∈ ℝ and every q-covector α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) q: covectorEuclideanNorm (c • α) = |c| · covectorEuclideanNorm α. Here covectorEuclideanNorm α = √(Σ_{I : Fin q → Fin P} t_I(α)), where t_I(α) = α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(q−1)})² if I is strictly increasing and t_I(α) = 0 otherwise, and e_i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) q), covectorEuclideanNorm (c • α) = |c| * covectorEuclideanNorm α
